title: On the Doppler Effect in Static Materials: Vortices and Black, White and Worm-Hole Like Wave Trajectories
abstract: We demonstrate the Doppler effect in a static material. The effect is achieved with a network of thin waveguides whose lengths depend on the direction of travel, chosen to simulate the compression and expansion of the wave experienced by a source travelling with velocity $v$. Each edge of length $\ell$ becomes a pair of waveguides of lengths $\ell/(1\mp v/c)$, one for each direction of travel. On a lattice this gives the field pattern of a moving source. To demonstrate the effect, we design a vortex, an analogue black hole and wormhole.
subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology (gr-qc)

summaries.en: The authors realize a Doppler effect in a completely static material by using a network of thin waveguides whose per-edge lengths are direction-dependently rescaled as ℓ/(1∓v/c), thereby reproducing the field pattern of a source moving at velocity v and allowing them to design analogues of a vortex, a black hole, and a wormhole.
summaries.zh: 作者通过在完全静态的材料中使用细波导网络实现了多普勒效应，其中每条边的长度按方向依赖的方式缩放为ℓ/(1∓v/c)，从而重现以速度v运动的源的场分布，并据此设计了涡旋、黑洞和虫洞的类比。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、各辺の長さを進行方向に依存してℓ/(1∓v/c)に再スケーリングした細い導波路網を用いることで、完全に静的的な材料中でドップラー効果を実現し、速度vで運動する源の場のパターンを再現するとともに、渦、ブラックホール、ワームホールのアナログを設計した。

title: Co layer Thickness Driven Structural Evolution and Magnetic Behaviour of Co/Ir/Co Trilayers
abstract: Ferromagnetic heavy-metal (FM/HM) trilayer heterostructures provide a versatile platform for investigating the interplay between structural and magnetic properties. In this study, we investigate the effect of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of sputter-deposited $\mathrm{Co}(t_{\mathrm{Co}})/\mathrm{Ir}(5\,\mathrm{nm})/\mathrm{Co}(t_{\mathrm{Co}})$ varying from 2 to 10 nm. Structural characterization using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) reveals a nanocrystalline structure, with the crystallite size increasing with Co-layer thickness. Furthermore, X-ray reflectivity (XRR) reveals a thickness-dependent variation in interface morphology, with the interface roughness ratio reaching a maximum at $t_{\mathrm{Co}} = 4$ nm. Temperature-dependent zero-field-cooled and field-cooled (ZFC-FC) magnetization measurements reveal thickness-dependent characteristic temperatures and multiple relaxation regimes in selected samples, indicating complex thermally activated magnetic behaviour. In contrast, field-dependent hysteresis measurements reveal that the saturation magnetization increases with Co-layer thickness, whereas the coercivity exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic variation, with enhanced values at intermediate thicknesses. Moreover, low-temperature hysteresis loops display thickness-dependent exchange-bias-like shifts, particularly for $t_{\mathrm{Co}} = 2$-$4$ nm. These findings highlight the strong influence of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of Co/Ir/Co trilayers.
subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: Increasing the Co layer thickness in sputter-deposited Co/Ir/Co trilayers enlarges the nanocrystallite size, alters interface morphology, raises saturation magnetization, produces a non-monotonic coercivity with enhanced values at intermediate thicknesses, and yields thickness-dependent exchange-bias-like shifts at low temperature, demonstrating strong thickness control of structural and magnetic properties.
summaries.zh: 在溅射沉积的Co/Ir/Co三层膜中，增加Co层厚度会增大纳米晶粒尺寸、改变界面形貌、提高饱和磁化强度，使矫顽力呈现非单调变化并在中间厚度处增强，同时在低温下产生随厚度变化的类交换偏置位移，表明Co层厚度强烈调控其结构与磁性能。
summaries.ja: スパッタ成膜したCo/Ir/Co三層膜においてCo層厚を増加させると、ナノ結晶子サイズの増大、界面形態の変化、飽和磁化の増加、中間厚さで増強される非単調な保磁力変化、および低温での厚さ依存の交換バイアス様シフトが生じ、Co層厚が構造と磁気特性を強く制御することが示された。

title: Perpendicular Anisotropy and g-Factor of Sputtered Ni Films on Si(111) Studied by Angle-Dependent Ferromagnetic Resonance
abstract: Ni films with thicknesses of 312 and 1011\,Å were grown on Si(111) by dc magnetron sputtering at room temperature and studied by atomic force microscopy, grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, magnetometry and angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance. Both films are polycrystalline fcc Ni with smooth surfaces, a bulk-like (111) lattice spacing and a saturation magnetization of ${\approx}480$\,emu\,cm$^{-3}$, and both are magnetized in plane. The angular dependence of the resonance field, from the film plane to the film normal, is described by a uniaxial anisotropy model with first- and second-order terms. From this model, $g = 2.160\pm0.005$ and $2.101\pm0.014$ and effective perpendicular anisotropies of $(6.0\pm0.4)\times10^{5}$ and $(4.5\pm0.6)\times10^{5}$\,erg\,cm$^{-3}$ were obtained for the thinner and thicker film, respectively. The conventional analysis of only the in-plane and perpendicular resonances gives $g$-factors that are lower by 0.02--0.04. The perpendicular linewidths give upper limits for the Gilbert damping of $\alpha \le 0.030$ and $\le 0.038$.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: Angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance shows that sputtered polycrystalline fcc Ni films on Si(111) are in-plane magnetized with g-factors of 2.
summaries.zh: 角度依赖的铁磁共振表明，溅射在Si(111)上的多晶面心立方Ni薄膜为面内磁化，312和1011 Å薄膜的g因子分别为2.
summaries.ja: 角度依存強磁性共鳴により、Si(111)上にスパッタ成膜した多結晶fcc Ni薄膜は面内磁化を示し、312および1011 Å膜のg因子はそれぞれ2.

title: First-Principles-Informed Modeling of Thermal Transport and Laser-Induced Heating in Ultrahigh-Temperature Carbides
abstract: Using first-principles density functional theory and Boltzmann transport calculations, we systematically investigate the electronic structure, lattice and electronic thermal transport, optical response, and laser-induced heating of ultrahigh-temperature carbides (UHTCs), including Group IV (TiC, ZrC, and HfC) and Group V carbides (VC, NbC, and TaC), and SiC. The transition-metal carbides (TMCs) exhibit metallic electronic structures, whereas SiC exhibits semiconducting character. The calculated thermal transport properties reveal distinct contributions from phonons and electrons, with electronic heat transport becoming increasingly important at elevated temperatures in TMCs. The Group V carbides exhibit substantially lower lattice thermal conductivity than their Group IV counterparts, accompanied by pronounced Kohn anomalies and modified phonon dispersions associated with their distinct electronic structures, suggesting a possible connection between Fermi-surface topology, phonon dynamics, and lattice thermal transport. In contrast, SiC exhibits comparatively high lattice thermal conductivity, consistent with its long-lived acoustic phonons, but no electronic contribution due to its semiconducting nature. Optical calculations reveal relatively high reflectivity in the visible and infrared spectral ranges for the metallic carbides, whereas SiC exhibits lower reflectivity in the infrared region. Finally, one-dimensional and three-dimensional continuum heat-conduction models are employed to compare the thermal responses of these materials under specified laser irradiation conditions. The predicted temperature distributions depend on the thermal and optical properties of the materials as well as the specimen geometry.

summaries.en: First-principles density functional theory and Boltzmann transport calculations reveal distinct phonon and electron contributions to thermal transport in ultrahigh-temperature carbides, with Group V carbides showing lower lattice thermal conductivity linked to Kohn anomalies, metallic carbides exhibiting high visible-infrared reflectivity, and continuum models predicting laser-induced heating that depends on material properties and specimen geometry.
summaries.zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论和玻尔兹曼输运计算揭示了超高温碳化物中声子与电子对热输运的不同贡献，其中第V族碳化物因Kohn异常而表现出较低的晶格热导率，金属性碳化物在可见光和红外波段具有较高反射率，而连续介质模型预测的激光诱导加热取决于材料性质和样品几何形状。
summaries.ja: 第一原理密度汎関数理論とボルツマン輸送計算により、超高温炭化物におけるフォノンと電子の熱輸送への寄与が明らかになり、第V族炭化物はコーン異常に関連して低い格子熱伝導率を示し、金属性炭化物は可視・赤外域で高い反射率を持ち、連続体モデルで予測されるレーザー誘起加熱は材料特性と試料形状に依存することが示された。

title: Momentum-selective graphene spectroscopy of moiré excitons
abstract: Far-field photoluminescence probes only the light-cone corner of an exciton's momentum content, whereas energy transfer to nearby graphene integrates in-plane momenta up to the inverse spacer thickness $1/z$. For a WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ heterobilayer we build the transition polarization $\bm{P}_n(\qv)$ of each localized moiré exciton from the registry-dependent vector dipole texture and use each $\bm{P}_n$ for both baths. The two baths rank the states differently: the graphene-rate ratios differ from the optical ones, their ordering inverts with spacer thickness, and the distance exponents at $z=10$\,nm spread by more than two units. These ratios are independent of the transition-dipole prefactor. Within the $C_3$-symmetric leading-harmonic model the chiral $p_+$ and $d_-$ states are also dark at normal incidence yet transfer to graphene at rates comparable to the bright ground state. Their graphene rate depends on the sign of the texture phase, a quantity invisible in far-field emission, which we determine from first principles. In a device this prediction requires a splitting, larger than the symmetry-breaking mixing, that protects the chiral partners. Graphene proximity thus acts as a momentum-selective near-field probe of moiré excitons, and we propose its use as a practical spectroscopy.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: Moiré excitons in a WSe2/MoSe2 heterobilayer are probed momentum-selectively via near-field energy transfer to graphene, whose rates rank states differently from far-field optical emission and reveal chiral p+ and d− states that are dark at normal incidence yet transfer at bright-like rates depending on a texture-phase sign determined from first principles.
summaries.zh: 本文通过向石墨烯的近场能量转移对WSe2/MoSe2异质双层中的莫尔激子进行动量选择性探测，其速率对量子态的排序与远场光学发射不同，并揭示了在正入射下暗、但以接近亮态速率转移的手性p+与d−态，其转移速率取决于由第一性原理确定的织构相位符号。
summaries.ja: WSe2/MoSe2ヘテロ二層のモアレ励起子をグラフェンへの近接場エネルギー移動により運動量選択的に調べると、その速度による状態の順位は遠方場発光とは異なり、垂直入射では暗いが明状態に匹敵する速度で移動するキラルなp+およびd−状態が現れ、その移動速度は第一原理から決定したテクスチャ位相の符号に依存する。

title: Spin and Charge Photocurrents from Electric-Magnetic Dipole Interference in Centrosymmetric Crystals
abstract: A common view regarding even-order nonlinear optical (NLO) effects, such as second-harmonic generation and the bulk photovoltaic effect, is that the breaking of inversion symmetry is necessary. However, this view relies on the assumption that light interacts with materials solely through its electric field. Here, we demonstrate that interference between the electric and magnetic components of the same light field can induce even-order NLO effects even in centrosymmetric materials. Using charge and spin photocurrents as prototypical examples, we present a unified microscopic theory showing how such electric-magnetic dipole interference (EMDI) drives NLO responses in inversion-symmetric crystals. Bilinear in both electric and magnetic fields, these responses scale linearly with light intensity. Combining symmetry analysis with first-principles calculations, we decompose the EMDI-induced photocurrents into shift-like and injection-like contributions and classify their dependence on crystal symmetry, time-reversal symmetry, and light polarization. Notably, we reveal that these EMDI-induced responses in centrosymmetric materials are weaker than conventional responses in non-centrosymmetric materials roughly by a factor of fine structure constant $\alpha \approx [10^{-3}\text{--}10^{-2}] $. Nevertheless, they remain well within experimental reach. Our work thus unlocks NLO functionalities in centrosymmetric materials for e.g., materials characterization, photonics and optoelectronics. This is vital given that many functionally importantly materials, such as cubic Si and cubic $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$, possess inversion symmetry.

summaries.en: The paper shows that interference between the electric and magnetic components of light can drive even-order nonlinear optical responses, including charge and spin photocurrents, in centrosymmetric crystals, with strengths suppressed relative to conventional non-centrosymmetric responses by roughly the fine-structure constant but still experimentally accessible.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，光的电场与磁场分量之间的干涉可在中心对称晶体中驱动包括电荷与自旋光电流在内的偶数阶非线性光学响应，其强度比非中心对称材料中的常规响应弱约精细结构常数倍，但仍处于实验可及范围。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、光の電場成分と磁場成分の干渉が、電荷・スピン光電流を含む偶数次の非線形光学応答を反転対称性をもつ結晶においても誘起できることを示し、その応答は非中心対称材料における従来の応答より微細構造定数程度小さいものの実験的に十分観測可能であると明らかにした。

title: Matter that learns what matters
abstract: Can a material learn what deserves its attention? We show that it can in a model optical network, in which action outcomes train a persistent record in each link. The record biases whether a source is consulted and sets how strongly it changes a stored answer, so useful sources gain attention and influence without being identified in advance. The network's experience thus shapes the information available for its future learning. Resonant readouts make this learning fragile: reinforcement can carry a record past resonance, where it persists but its influence weakens. We derive bounds within which relevant signals guide the answer, irrelevant signals are rejected and stored answers remain open to revision. These bounds guide a learning rule that limits reinforcement as records form; in simulations, it acquires useful records and keeps them functional. When relevance changes, an obsolete record can block its own replacement. A local state that strengthens negative writing after unsuccessful actions releases obsolete records and completes the learning sequence more often. How a memory is read should decide how it is written.
subjects: Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn) ; Emerging Technologies (cs.ET); Adaptation and Self-Organizing Systems (nlin.AO); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: A model optical network can learn which sources to attend to by storing a persistent, resonance-sensitive record in each link that biases source consultation and answer revision, with derived bounds guiding a learning rule that limits reinforcement and a local state that strengthens negative writing to release obsolete records.
summaries.zh: 一个模型光学网络能够学习关注哪些信息源，它通过在每个连接中存储一个对共振敏感的持久记录来偏置信息源的查询和答案的修正，并依据推导出的边界指导一种限制强化的学习规则，同时利用一种在失败动作后增强负向写入的局部状态来释放过时记录。
summaries.ja: モデル光ネットワークは、各リンクに共鳴に敏感な持続的記録を保存して情報源の参照と答えの修正を偏らせることでどの情報源に注意すべきかを学習でき、導出された境界が強化を制限する学習規則を導き、失敗行動後に負の書き込みを強める局所状態が不要な記録を解放する。

title: Role of site-specific coordination for the structural and electronic properties of a Co-HATCN network on silver
abstract: Two-dimensional metal-organic porous networks (2DMOPNs) on metal surfaces provide a versatile platform for exploring emergent electronic and magnetic phenomena in designed surface nanostructures. While the porous architecture is governed by coordination between molecular building blocks and metal centers, most 2DMOPNs utilize only one type of coordination site, leaving the impact of multiple coordination sites largely unexplored. We address this question by investigating the structural formation of a Co-coordinated 2DMOPN on Ag(111) with the linker molecule hexaazatriphenylene-hexacarbonitrile (HATCN), which has two chemically distinct nitrogen coordination sites at the peripheral nitrile groups and pyrazine-type core nitrogen atoms. Scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) reveals the transformation from a simple honeycomb HATCN structure to a Co-coordinated porous network with three structurally and electronically inequivalent molecules in a 6:3:1 ratio. The existence of two distinct coordination sites leads to selective Co coordination geometries for all three molecules, accompanied by site-specific charge transfer from Co into the former lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO), as revealed by momentum-resolved photoemission and density functional theory. Our results demonstrate that site-selective Co coordination not only controls the overall architecture of the porous network structure but also strongly influences the local electronic properties through site-specific metal-molecule interaction, providing a route to tailor the site-specific electronic structure of 2DMOPNs at the molecular level.

summaries.en: A Co-coordinated two-dimensional metal-organic porous network formed on Ag(111) with HATCN linkers exhibits three structurally and electronically inequivalent molecules in a 6:3:1 ratio, where site-selective Co coordination at the molecule's distinct nitrile and pyrazine nitrogen sites controls both the network architecture and site-specific charge transfer into the former LUMO.
summaries.zh: 在Ag(111)表面由HATCN连接分子形成的钴配位二维金属有机多孔网络呈现三种结构和电子性质不等价的分子，比例为6:3:1，其中钴在分子不同的腈基氮和吡嗪型氮配位位点上的位点选择性配位不仅控制网络结构，还通过位点特异的金属-分子相互作用决定向原最低未占据分子轨道的电荷转移。
summaries.ja: Ag(111)上でHATCN連結分子を用いて形成されたCo配位二次元金属有機多孔質ネットワークは、6:3:1の比率で構造的・電子的に非等価な3種の分子を示し、分子のニトリル窒素部位とピラジン型窒素部位への部位選択的なCo配位がネットワーク構造を制御するとともに、部位特異的な金属-分子相互作用を通じて元の最低非占有分子軌道への電荷移動を決定づける。

title: From Autonomous Knowledge Generation to Generalizable Property Prediction: A Precision-First Pipeline for Electro-Optic Materials Discovery
abstract: Electro-optic materials, whose refractive index changes linearly with an applied electric field (the Pockels effect), set the speed and energy of optical modulators and microwave-to-optical links for quantum computing. Designing better materials requires optimizing composition alongside temperature, strain, and bias field. However, general repositories lack electro-optic tensor data. We present a pipeline that builds such a database from literature following the rule: "no value is better than a wrong value." The pipeline has five stages: physics-aware acquisition, layout-aware extraction via LLM and deterministic table parsers, a three-tier verification gate, cross-paper consensus using median and median absolute deviation, and a noise-robust surrogate model audited by leave-one-material-out (LOMO) testing. Physics enters directly: notation is mapped, point-group symmetry-forbidden Pockels components are rejected, equivalent labels are merged, and values carry provenance tags. In a run over 49 publications, the gate processed 816 candidates into 414 accepted, 215 held for review, and 187 rejected. Against a hand-certified gold standard of 303 values from 16 papers, the run achieved a precision of 0.51 and recall of 0.48 for exact record matches. Across four database snapshots, held-out materials where the surrogate model beat a predict-the-mean baseline grew from 1 of 4 to 9 of 13 as the database expanded from 10 to 22 materials. While not a controlled comparison, this trend supports the premise that a precision-oriented, physics-checked database can power forward models beyond its training set and clarifies requirements for inverse material design.

summaries.en: The paper presents a precision-first, physics-aware pipeline that extracts and verifies electro-optic tensor data from literature to build a curated database and train a noise-robust surrogate model that generalizes to held-out materials.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种以精度为先、具备物理感知的流程，从文献中提取并验证电光张量数据，构建精选数据库并训练出可泛化到未见材料的抗噪代理模型。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、文献から電気光学テンソルデータを抽出・検証して精選データベースを構築し、未見材料にも汎化するノイズ耐性のあるサロゲートモデルを訓練する、精度優先かつ物理を考慮したパイプラインを提示する。

title: No Value Is Better Than a Wrong Value: Finding and Handling Erroneous Data in Literature-Mined Datasets for AI
abstract: Machine learning across materials science, chemistry, energy, and medicine increasingly relies on literature-extracted datasets due to a lack of curated databases. However, automated extraction introduces errors: text recognition misreads digits, units and notations are confused, values are misattributed, and LLMs hallucinate numbers. Drawing on our work building an electro-optic property database, we present a taxonomy of errors organized by their origin and signatures, alongside a layered framework for error detection. The framework combines schema and provenance checks, physical admissibility (bounds, symmetry, and governing equations), cross-source statistical consensus, model auditing, and suspicion-ranked review. In a production run, our verification gate halted 402 of 816 candidate values with typed reasons. Yet, an audit against curated references showed that 30 of 112 accepted values were defective; standard symmetry rules alone caught 21 of these. On measured BaTiO3 and KNbO3 tensors, constitutive identities caught 8 of 10 single-value errors and isolated the corrupted entries. In a controlled benchmark, the combined framework caught 81% of errors at 85% precision, including errors in single-report materials, bringing model accuracy on held-out data to within 3% of a model trained on clean data. Uncleaned data severely impairs discovery: 89% of the twenty largest values were errors, causing AI searches to prioritize false positives. Once bad numbers are controlled, missing measurement conditions emerge as the main limit, as distinct records become indistinguishable without full context. We outline directions for the field, including shared physics rule libraries and self-reporting databases.

summaries.en: The paper presents a taxonomy and layered verification framework for detecting erroneous literature-mined materials data, which caught 81% of errors at 85% precision and restored model accuracy to within 3% of clean-data models.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了针对文献挖掘材料数据的错误分类与分层验证框架，在85%精确率下捕获81%的错误，并使模型准确率恢复到与干净数据模型相差3%以内。
summaries.ja: 本論文は文献から抽出した材料データの誤り分類と階層的検証フレームワークを提示し、85%の精度で81%の誤りを検出して、モデル精度をクリーンなデータで学習したモデルとの差3%以内に回復させた。

title: A van der Waals Floating-Gate Platform for Broadband Optoelectronic Neuromorphic Computing
abstract: Artificial synapses that integrate nonvolatile memory with broadband optoelectronic learning are essential for next-generation neuromorphic computing. However, their realization remains challenging because conventional floating-gate memories exhibit limited optical functionality and poor scalability. Here, we report a van der Waals ReS2/hBN/InSe floating-gate synaptic transistor that combines efficient charge storage with broadband optoelectronic learning in a single device architecture. The heterostructure incorporates InSe as a floating-gate layer for stable charge storage, hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) as a tunneling dielectric, and ReS2 as a photoresponsive channel, enabling carrier tunneling under electrical and optical stimulation. Through the combined operation of these layers, the device achieves a large memory window, an on/off current ratio exceeding 10^6, stable multilevel conductance states, and reliable retention over 10^4 s. Broadband visible-to-near-infrared optical excitation enables controllable synaptic weight modulation and the emulation of essential synaptic functions, including short- and long-term plasticity, paired-pulse facilitation, and pulse-amplitude- and pulse-duration-dependent plasticity. Optical potentiation and electrical depression further enable bidirectional modulation of synaptic weights. Beyond these synaptic functions, the device demonstrates higher-order learning through associative and discrimination conditioning inspired by the Pavlovian learning paradigm, as well as reconfigurable Boolean logic driven by electro-optical inputs. These results establish a multifunctional van der Waals floating-gate platform that integrates nonvolatile memory, broadband optoelectronic learning, and adaptive information processing within a single transistor, providing a promising strategy for compact, energy-efficient neuromorphic hardware.

summaries.en: The paper reports a van der Waals ReS2/hBN/InSe floating-gate synaptic transistor that combines efficient charge storage with broadband visible-to-near-infrared optoelectronic learning, enabling multilevel conductance states, diverse synaptic plasticity, higher-order associative learning, and reconfigurable Boolean logic within a single device architecture.
summaries.zh: 本文报道了一种范德华ReS2/hBN/InSe浮栅突触晶体管，将高效电荷存储与可见光至近红外的宽带光电学习相结合，在单一器件结构中实现了多级电导态、多种突触可塑性、高阶联想学习以及可重构布尔逻辑。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、効率的な電荷蓄積と可視光から近赤外までの広帯域光電子学習を融合したファンデルワールスReS2/hBN/InSe浮遊ゲート型シナプストランジスタを報告し、単一デバイス構造において多値コンダクタンス状態、多様なシナプス可塑性、高次連想学習、および再構成可能なブール論理を実現した。

title: Nanoscale mapping of native defects in Td-MoTe2 and their impact on graphene-based van der Waals heterostructures
abstract: We investigate native defects and their impact on the electronic structure of Td-MoTe2 and graphene/Td-MoTe2 van der Waals heterostructures using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy. STM reveals a high density of circular, hollow surface defects that we attribute to Te vacancies. STS on pristine MoTe2 shows semimetallic, V-shaped dI/dV spectra with subtle low-energy states. The vacancies suppress the tunnelling conductance below the Fermi level without introducing new sharp defect-related resonances, consistent with a vacancy-induced redistribution of Mo-Te spectral weight rather than the appearance of new electronic states. In the heterostructure, graphene preserves these MoTe2 fingerprints with no noticeable graphene doping or charge transfer. Our results demonstrate that isolated native Te vacancies act as spectroscopically weak perturbations to the low-energy electronic structure of graphene. The graphene overlayer further screens their impact on the electronic structure, making graphene/Td-MoTe2 heterostructures intrinsically tolerant to such interface defects.

summaries.en: Using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, this study maps native Te vacancies in Td-MoTe2 and shows that they only weakly perturb the low-energy electronic structure without creating new defect resonances, with graphene in graphene/Td-MoTe2 heterostructures remaining undoped and screening their impact.
summaries.zh: 本研究利用扫描隧道显微镜和谱学技术绘制了Td-MoTe2中的原生Te空位，发现这些空位仅微弱扰动低能电子结构且不产生新的缺陷共振态，而石墨烯/Td-MoTe2异质结构中的石墨烯未发生掺杂并能屏蔽空位的影响。
summaries.ja: 走査トンネル顕微鏡と分光法を用いてTd-MoTe2の固有Te空孔をマッピングした本研究は、空孔が新たな欠陥共鳴状態を生じず低エネルギー電子構造を弱く摂動するのみであり、グラフェン/Td-MoTe2ヘテロ構造ではグラフェンがドープされず空孔の影響を遮蔽することを示した。

title: Optical Thermometry in Monolayer WS2: Raman and Photoluminescence Spectroscopy from 5 K to 1273 K
abstract: Reliable temperature measurement is essential for characterizing and engineering two-dimensional (2D) semiconductor devices, yet optical thermometry of 2D materials has so far been demonstrated only over narrow temperature windows spanning a few hundred kelvin. Here, we establish a comprehensive optical thermometry framework for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K. We show that: (i) the out-of-plane A1g Raman mode shifts linearly with temperature above 100~K, with a slope of -0.0138 cm^{-1}/K in non-encapsulated WS2 (fitted over 298-1223~K) and a measurably smaller slope of -0.0121 cm^{-1}/K in an hBN-encapsulated sample (fitted over 100-1273~K); (ii) photoluminescence spectra measured over the same 5--1273~K range provide an independent optical indicator of the temperature: the neutral-exciton emission redshifts continuously with temperature and is well described by the semi-empirical Pässler model. The two indicators probe distinct physical mechanisms, lattice anharmonicity and bandgap renormalization, and together provide contact-free thermometry for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K, an approach applicable to 2D semiconductors more broadly.

summaries.en: This study establishes contact-free optical thermometry for monolayer WS2 from 5 K to 1273 K using the linear temperature dependence of the out-of-plane A1g Raman mode above 100 K and the Pässler-model-described redshift of neutral-exciton photoluminescence, two indicators probing lattice anharmonicity and bandgap renormalization, respectively.
summaries.zh: 本研究利用100 K以上面外A1g拉曼模的线性温度依赖以及可用Pässler模型描述的中性激子光致发光红移，建立了单层WS2在5 K至1273 K范围内的非接触式光学测温方法，这两种指标分别探测晶格非谐性与带隙重整化。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、100 K以上で面外A1gラマンモードが線形に温度依存することと、Pässlerモデルで記述される中性励起子発光の赤方偏移を利用して、単層WS2の5 Kから1273 Kにわたる非接触光学温度測定を確立し、これら二つの指標はそれぞれ格子非調和性とバンドギャップ再規格化を反映する。

title: Interfacial bacteria-driven rotation of free-floating active droplets
abstract: Active droplets provide a platform for converting microscopic propulsion into macroscopic flow. Previous realizations of bacteria-driven droplet rotation typically rely on nearby solid boundaries, external fields, or dense active nematics. Here, we report autonomous rotation of droplets in a three-dimensional aqueous two-phase system driven by interfacial population of \textit{Pseudomonas aeruginosa}. Combining confocal microscopy with fluid particle dynamics simulations, we show that amphiphilic bacteria accumulate at the dextran--polyethylene glycol interface and preferentially move and orient along the local tangent. Interfacial localization partitions the force-free swimming dipole between the two liquid phases, allowing either phase to experience a finite active torque while the combined system remains torque balanced. The simulated interfacial population is more spatially heterogeneous than in the experiments, emphasizing that both the bacterial distribution and its signed orientational organization can influence the instantaneous torque. Over the accessible size range, the macroscopic angular velocity exhibits an inverse-radius ($R^{-1}$) dependence. We also formulate a theoretical model to rationalize this scaling law, revealing how the macroscopic rotation is governed by collective interfacial swimming and surface coverage. These results identify a fluid-interface-mediated route for converting swimmer activity into macroscopic rotational flow and establish a strategy for harnessing interfacial active matter to regulate droplet dynamics.

summaries.en: Interfacial accumulation of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in a three-dimensional aqueous two-phase system converts force-free swimming into autonomous droplet rotation with angular velocity scaling as the inverse radius, as shown by confocal microscopy and fluid particle dynamics simulations.
summaries.zh: 通过共聚焦显微镜和流体粒子动力学模拟表明，在三维水两相体系中，铜绿假单胞菌在界面的聚集将无净力游泳转化为液滴的自主旋转，其角速度随半径呈反比（R^-1）变化。
summaries.ja: 共焦点顕微鏡と流体粒子ダイナミクスシミュレーションにより、三次元水系二相系において緑膿菌が界面に集積することで無力遊泳が液滴の自発的回転へと変換され、その角速度が半径の逆数（R^-1）に比例することが示された。

title: Impact of organic spacer cations on the light and thermal stability of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites
abstract: Long-term stability remains a critical challenge limiting the photovoltaic and optoelectronic applications of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites. In these materials, the choice of the organic spacer plays a key role not only in enhancing environmental stability, but also in determining their structural characteristics and carrier dynamics. Here, we present an environmental photo- and thermal-stability analysis of BA2PbI4 and PEA2PbI4 two-dimensional lead halide perovskites by means of confocal micro-Raman and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy techniques. We have investigated two different organic spacers, n-butylammonium (BA) and 2-phenylethylammonium (PEA), which provide comparable room-temperature luminescence in freshly exfoliated perovskite nanoflakes and degrade similarly through the removal of organic components and fast crystal phase decomposition into PbI2 and Pb0. However, we observed that the PEA organic cation significantly improves crystal morphology and suppresses lattice defects, resulting in slower degradation and enhanced resistance to light and thermal stress under ambient conditions. Our findings indicate that structural and chemical engineering, along with surface passivation and encapsulation strategies, are essential for achieving long-term stability in two-dimensional halide perovskite devices. Nevertheless, optimizing the balance between stability and device performance remains a critical consideration.

summaries.en: This study uses confocal micro-Raman and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy to show that the 2-phenylethylammonium spacer improves crystal morphology and suppresses lattice defects in two-dimensional lead halide perovskites, yielding slower degradation and greater resistance to light and thermal stress under ambient conditions than the n-butylammonium spacer, although both degrade similarly through organic removal and phase decomposition into PbI2 and Pb0.
summaries.zh: 本研究利用共聚焦显微拉曼和X射线光电子能谱技术发现，与正丁基铵间隔阳离子相比，2-苯乙基铵间隔阳离子能改善二维卤化铅钙钛矿的晶体形貌并抑制晶格缺陷，从而在环境条件下表现出更慢的降解速率以及更强的抗光和热应力能力，尽管两者均通过有机组分脱除和向PbI2与Pb0的快速相分解而类似地降解。
summaries.ja: 本研究は共焦点マイクロラマン分光法とX線光電子分光法を用いて、2-フェニルエチルアンモニウムスペーサーがn-ブチルアンモニウムスペーサーと比べて二次元ハロゲン化鉛ペロブスカイトの結晶形態を改善し格子欠陥を抑制することで、有機成分の除去とPbI2およびPb0への急速な相分解という同様の劣化経路をたどりながらも、大気条件下でより遅い劣化と光・熱ストレスに対する高い耐性をもたらすことを明らかにした。

title: Higher-harmonic spin-wave excitation by a superconducting antenna with vortices
abstract: The interaction between superconductivity and magnetism provides new routes for controlling nonlinear excitations in hybrid systems. While dc-driven Abrikosov vortices (fluxons) are known to interact with spin waves, the ability of confined, nearly harmonic vortex oscillations to generate higher-frequency spin-wave modes remains unexplored. Here, by combining time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau modeling with spectral analysis of the microwave near field, we demonstrate higher-harmonic spin-wave excitation driven by a superconducting microstrip antenna in the Shubnikov phase. Unlike conventional harmonic-generation mechanisms associated with nonlinear magnetization dynamics, the magnetic layer remains a linear receiver, whereas the superconducting antenna generates the nonlinear microwave field. We show that nearly sinusoidal vortex motion and the accompanying redistribution of superconducting screening currents produce higher harmonics that couple to spin-wave modes. This response arises from spatial-to-temporal transduction, whereby harmonic vortex motion and the associated redistribution of screening currents convert a spatially nonuniform magnetic-field profile into higher temporal harmonics. Magnetic flux quanta thus act as active nonlinear elements for frequency conversion, extending the accessible spin-wave frequency range in superconducting--magnonic hybrids.

summaries.en: By combining time-dependent Ginzburg–Landau modeling with microwave near-field spectral analysis, the authors show that nearly sinusoidal vortex oscillations in a superconducting microstrip antenna redistribute screening currents and convert a spatially nonuniform magnetic-field profile into higher temporal harmonics that excite higher-harmonic spin waves in a linear magnetic layer, making flux quanta active nonlinear elements for frequency conversion in superconducting–magnonic hybrids.
summaries.zh: 通过将含时金兹堡-朗道模型与微波近场频谱分析相结合，作者表明超导微带天线中近乎正弦的涡旋振荡会重新分布屏蔽电流，并将空间非均匀的磁场分布转换为更高的时间谐波，从而在磁性层保持线性的情况下激发高次谐波自旋波，使磁通量子成为超导-磁振子混合体系中实现频率转换的主动非线性元件。
summaries.ja: 時間依存ギンツブルグ–ランダウ模型とマイクロ波近接場のスペクトル解析を組み合わせることで、超伝導マイクロストリップアンテナ内のほぼ正弦的な渦運動が遮蔽電流の再分布を引き起こし、空間的に不均一な磁場分布をより高い時間高調波へ変換して、線形な磁性層において高調波スピン波を励起することを示し、磁束量子を超伝導–マグノニクス複合系における周波数変換の能動的非線形素子として位置づけた。

title: Pulsed Laser Deposition of Ferroelectric SrTiO3 Shells Enables Polarization-Controlled Charge Separation in TiO2 Photoanode
abstract: Ferroelectric polarization offers a powerful route to govern the interfacial charge separation in photoelectrodes; however, chemically converted ferroelectric shells lack sub-nanometer thickness control, coherent strain retention, and chemically clean interfaces. Here, we use pulsed laser deposition to fabricate stoichiometric SrTiO3 shells on hydrothermally grown TiO2 nanorod arrays, achieving atomically defined core-shell architectures while preserving the one-dimensional transport geometry. The photocurrent density followed a volcano-shaped dependence on shell thickness and reached 1.9 mA cm-2 at 1.23 V versus RHE under AM 1.5G illumination for the optimized 15-mins sample, exceeding the established hydrothermal benchmark. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy revealed a tetragonally distorted, oxygen-stoichiometric shell, identifying coherent interfacial strain rather than defect dipoles as the origin of the ferroelectric order. Kelvin probe force microscopy directly imaged a polarization-induced built-in electric field whose magnitude scaled with charge-transfer efficiency and photocurrent density. Together, these complementary structural, chemical, electrostatic, and device-level measurements established a quantitative strain-polarization-built-in field-charge separation relationship. This work transforms ferroelectric photoanode engineering from empirical optimization into an atomically controllable and predictive materials strategy for high-efficiency solar water-splitting devices. This approach is readily extendable to visible-light absorbers and complex ferroelectric heterostructures.

summaries.en: Pulsed laser deposition was used to grow stoichiometric ferroelectric SrTiO3 shells on TiO2 nanorod arrays, where coherent interfacial strain induces polarization and a built-in field that boosts charge separation, yielding 1.
summaries.zh: 采用脉冲激光沉积在TiO2纳米棒阵列上生长化学计量比的铁电SrTiO3壳层，相干界面应变诱导极化与内建电场从而增强电荷分离，优化15分钟壳层样品在1.
summaries.ja: パルスレーザー堆積法によりTiO2ナノロッド上に化学量論的な強誘電体SrTiO3シェルを形成し、コヒーレントな界面ひずみに由来する分極と内部電界が電荷分離を促進し、最適化した15分試料で1.

title: Giant third-order nonlinearity amplifies second-harmonic transport in Ca3Ru2O7
abstract: Nonlinear electrical transport enables the conversion and detection of electromagnetic signals, supporting wireless energy harvesting, sensing and frequency conversion. Achieving both a large response and electrical tunability remains a central materials challenge. Here we harness giant third-order nonlinearity to amplify and electrically control second-harmonic transport in the correlated polar metal Ca3Ru2O7. Superposing a dc bias on an ac excitation enhances the second-harmonic signal by more than an order of magnitude. The bias controls the polarity of the induced response and activates channels forbidden by symmetry at zero bias. Both transverse and longitudinal components scale quadratically with the ac excitation and are odd in the dc bias, with angular dependences consistent with third-order conductivity. The underlying third-harmonic electric-field responsivity reaches 4.5 \times 10-6 m2V-2 at 3 K, providing a quantitative measure of the strong nonlinearity. The induced response emerges below the spin-reorientation transition near 48 K, linking its enhancement to the reconstructed low-temperature electronic state. Theoretical calculations identify quantum-geometric contributions to the nonlinear conductivity and reproduce the observed response symmetry. These results demonstrate how strong higher-order nonlinearity can amplify an effective second-order response, providing a route to electrically tunable nonlinear transport in correlated materials.

summaries.en: A large third-order nonlinearity in the correlated polar metal Ca3Ru2O7 amplifies and electrically controls second-harmonic transport, with a dc bias enhancing the second-harmonic signal by more than an order of magnitude and enabling symmetry-forbidden channels.
summaries.zh: 在关联极性金属Ca3Ru2O7中，巨大的三阶非线性放大了二次谐波输运并实现电学调控，施加直流偏置可使二次谐波信号增强一个数量级以上，并激活零偏置下受对称性禁止的通道。
summaries.ja: 相関極性金属Ca3Ru2O7における巨大な三次非線形性が第二次高調波輸送を増幅し電気的に制御することを可能にし、直流バイアスを印加すると第二次高調波信号が一桁以上増強され、ゼロバイアスでは対称性により禁じられたチャネルが活性化される。

title: Local Broadband Gigahertz Spectroscopy via SQUID-on-Tip DC Readout
abstract: Superconducting microwave circuits are shaped by their local electromagnetic environment, yet standard microwave measurements do not resolve the local fields and device features that govern their behavior. Here, we combine microwave spectroscopy, nanoscale magnetic sensing, and topographic imaging in a single tapping-mode SQUID-on-tip microscope. The nonlinear Josephson response converts local GHz excitations into Shapiro steps, enabling quantitative measurements of microwave frequency signals and their excitation strength using only DC readout. Applied to a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator, local spectroscopy reproduces the power-dependent resonance and nonlinear bifurcation observed in microwave transmission measurements. Spatially resolved measurements map the microwave response while simultaneously recording topography and static magnetic features, including vortices and Meissner screening currents. Electromagnetic simulations reveal how coupling through the superconducting probe leads limits spatial resolution and guides localized detector designs. Together, these capabilities establish a platform for correlating microwave circuit dynamics with the local structural and magnetic environment of superconducting devices.

summaries.en: A tapping-mode SQUID-on-tip microscope combines microwave spectroscopy, nanoscale magnetic sensing, and topographic imaging, using the nonlinear Josephson response to convert local GHz excitations into Shapiro steps for quantitative DC-readout measurements of microwave signals that reproduce resonator behavior and map local fields.
summaries.zh: 一种敲击模式SQUID针尖显微镜结合了微波光谱、纳米级磁传感和形貌成像，利用非线性约瑟夫森响应将局部GHz激发转换为Shapiro台阶，从而仅通过直流读出对微波信号进行定量测量，并重现谐振器行为并绘制局部场分布。
summaries.ja: タッピングモードSQUIDオンTip顕微鏡がマイクロ波分光、ナノスケール磁気センシング、トポグラフィーイメージングを統合し、非線形ジョセフソン応答により局所GHz励起をShapiroステップへ変換して直流読み出しのみでマイクロ波信号を定量的に測定し、共振器挙動の再現と局所場のマッピングを実現した。

title: Information-theoretic entropy imaging of quantum matter
abstract: Phase transitions can generate intricate spatial organization invisible to spatially averaged probes, yet quantitative measures of this organization remain limited. Here we develop "entropy imaging," an information-theoretic technique that harnesses lossless compression to quantify spatial complexity, predictability, and order in quantum materials. Using this approach, emergent spatial textures can be imaged and converted into an experimentally-accessible observable: the computable information density (CID), a compression-based measure of information complexity that approaches the Shannon entropy rate in the large-system limit. Applied to millikelvin microwave impedance microscopy of graphene, the method reveals a pronounced maximum in the CID near quantum Hall transitions, a quantitative measure of the information-rich spatial organization of the critical landscape. A disordered Hofstadter model reproduces this behavior and shows that the CID can identify the quantum critical point from a sequence of images, without ensemble averaging over disorder realizations. The same framework tracks fractional quantum Hall transitions and resolves isolated fractional puddles that coexist with a disordered background. By contrast, the trivial band-edge crossover in a MoSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer exhibits qualitatively different behavior, suggesting that the pronounced CID enhancement observed at the quantum Hall critical point is not simply a generic feature of a conductive-insulating crossover. We further show that the geometric information encoded in CID is not reducible to a correlation length, and it can even distinguish spatial textures with identical multifractal statistics. Together, these results establish lossless compression as a framework for quantifying emergent spatial organization in quantum materials, with portability across imaging modalities and physical systems.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)

summaries.en: The authors introduce entropy imaging, a lossless-compression-based information-theoretic method whose computable information density quantifies spatial complexity in quantum materials, and use it on microwave impedance microscopy of graphene to reveal a CID maximum at quantum Hall transitions that is reproduced by a disordered Hofstadter model, tracks fractional quantum Hall transitions and isolated fractional puddles, distinguishes the behavior of a MoSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer crossover, and is not reducible to a correlation length or multifractal statistics.
summaries.zh: 作者提出“熵成像”这一基于无损压缩的信息论方法，用可计算信息密度（CID）量化量子材料中的空间复杂性，并将其用于石墨烯的微波阻抗显微成像，发现量子霍尔转变附近CID出现显著极大值，无序Hofstadter模型可重现该行为，该方法还能追踪分数量子霍尔转变和孤立的分数填充区域，区分MoSe2/WS2莫尔异质双层中平庸带边交叉的不同行为，且CID所编码的几何信息不能归结为关联长度或相同多重分形统计。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、ロスレス圧縮に基づく情報理論的手法である「エントロピーイメージング」を開発し、計算可能情報密度（CID）によって量子物質の空間的複雑さを定量化するとともに、グラフェンのマイクロ波インピーダンス顕微鏡観測に適用して量子ホール転移付近でCIDが顕著な極大を示すことを明らかにし、無秩序Hofstadter模型がこの挙動を再現し、分数量子ホール転移や孤立した分数量子プールの追跡、MoSe2/WS2モアレヘテロ二層の自明なバンド端クロスオーバーとの質的違いの識別が可能であり、CIDに符号化される幾何学的情報は相関長や同一のマルチフラクタル統計に還元できないことを示した。

title: Third harmonic generation in the transition metal trichalcogenides
abstract: The transition metal trichalcogenides (TMTs) are an interesting class of layered 2D materials that have strong anisotropic electrical and optical properties. We report on the polarization-dependent nonlinear optical response of exfoliated crystals at the third harmonic using non-resonant excitation with a 1560 nm femtosecond laser. All members of the TMT crystal family explored (ZrS3, HfS3, TiS3, and NbS3) display large anisotropy in their polarized third harmonic generation signal, with anisotropy ratios as large as chi_11/chi_22 ~ 6.5. From the expected nonlinear dependence of these monoclinic and triclinic crystals we extract the relative nonlinear susceptibility coefficients. We find that the anisotropy ratio is largest for ZrS3 and decreases across the family, a trend we associate with the proximity of the third harmonic energy to the strongly b-polarized absorption edge of each material. NbS3, the only triclinic crystal, displays a pronounced anisotropy in thick flakes that is strongly reduced in the thinnest flakes, which we attribute to a partial relaxation of the Peierls-type Nb-Nb dimerization that underlies the triclinic distortion. The large anisotropic nonlinear response in this crystal family sets it apart from other 2D materials and makes it particularly attractive for further investigation.

summaries.en: Polarization-dependent third harmonic generation measurements on exfoliated ZrS3, HfS3, TiS3, and NbS3 crystals under non-resonant 1560 nm femtosecond excitation reveal large anisotropic nonlinear susceptibilities with ratios up to χ11/χ22 ~ 6.
summaries.zh: 对剥离的ZrS3、HfS3、TiS3和NbS3晶体在1560 nm飞秒激光非共振激发下进行的偏振相关三次谐波测量显示，其非线性极化率具有大的各向异性，比值最高达χ11/χ22 ~ 6.
summaries.ja: 非共鳴の1560 nmフェムト秒励起下での剥離したZrS3、HfS3、TiS3、NbS3結晶の偏光依存第三次高調波測定により、最大χ11/χ22 ~ 6.

title: Cavity Loss in QED Coupled-Cluster Theory: Polariton Linewidths, Driven Steady States, and the Rabi Splitting
abstract: Molecular polariton experiments are performed in lossy cavities, whereas correlated ab initio polariton theory has been developed almost entirely for lossless cavities. In this work, cavity loss is added to real-time QED coupled-cluster theory (QED-CCSD-22) through a complex cavity frequency, which gives the non-Hermitian no-jump part of the Lindblad master equation. The resulting polariton linewidths and driven-dissipative steady states are, to our knowledge, the first from QED coupled-cluster theory. The linewidths obtained from the complex Jacobian and from real-time propagation agree and are partitioned by the biorthogonal photon numbers of the two polaritons. A closed-form continuous-wave drive of the cavity gives driven steady states and their lineshapes.

summaries.en: Cavity loss is incorporated into real-time QED coupled-cluster theory (QED-CCSD-22) via a complex cavity frequency representing the non-Hermitian no-jump part of the Lindblad master equation, yielding the first QED coupled-cluster predictions of polariton linewidths and driven-dissipative steady states, with linewidths from the complex Jacobian and real-time propagation in agreement and partitioned by the biorthogonal photon numbers of the two polaritons.
summaries.zh: 通过引入复腔频率（对应Lindblad主方程的非厄米无跃迁部分），将腔损耗加入实时QED耦合簇理论（QED-CCSD-22），首次由QED耦合簇理论得到极化激元线宽与驱动耗散稳态，其中复雅可比与实时传播所得线宽一致，并按两个极化激元的双正交光子数进行分配。
summaries.ja: 複素キャビティ周波数（Lindbladマスター方程式の非エルミートなノージャンプ部分に対応）によってキャビティ損失を実時間QED結合クラスター理論（QED-CCSD-22）に導入し、QED結合クラスター理論から初めてポラリトンの線幅と駆動散逸定常状態を得るとともに、複素ヤコビアンと実時間伝播から得た線幅が一致し、二つのポラリトンの双直交光子数で分配されることを示した。

title: Contact-Free Nuclear and Cytoplasmic Mechanophenotyping by Amplitude-Modulated Ultrasound and Phase-Locked Optical Diffraction Tomography: Computational Feasibility and Initial Experimental Readouts
abstract: We investigate whether acoustic stimulation combined with phase-locked optical diffraction tomography (ODT) could measure the mechanical responses of the nucleus and cytoplasm separately in adherent cells. A megahertz ultrasound carrier is amplitude-modulated at low frequencies, while angle-scanned holography provides a route to reconstruct the first-harmonic refractive-index response in three dimensions. We built a computational model connecting viscoelastic finite-element simulations of MDA-MB-231 cells with a refractive-index phantom, hologram formation, camera noise and ODT reconstruction. Under an assumed 0.1 Pa harmonic shear traction at 10 Hz, the model predicts 3.6 to 9.2 nm of nuclear shear and 6.6 to 15.1 nm of apical motion. The nuclear-to-cytoplasmic amplitude ratio (R_A) is primarily sensitive to stiffness contrast in the tested scenarios, while the relative phase (Delta phi) responds to differences in dissipation. A simulated protocol using 100 illumination angles and 16 phase visits per angle recovered an imposed stiffening and recovery trajectory after averaging four acquisitions. We also obtained initial 3D tomograms of adherent MDA-MB-231 cells and report preliminary regional measurements from five cells. Their mean amplitude ratio was 0.616 plus or minus 0.098, and their mean relative phase was -1.91 plus or minus 0.58 degrees (mean and between-cell sample standard deviation). All five amplitude ratios were below unity, and all phase differences were negative, consistent with the qualitative directions of selected model scenarios. The small cohort and the absence of independently quantified experimental phase noise prevent a claim of quantitative mechanical validation. Together, these results support further evaluation of phase-locked acoustic ODT and identify experimental requirements for a controlled validation study.

summaries.en: This study computationally and preliminarily experimentally assesses whether amplitude-modulated megahertz ultrasound combined with phase-locked optical diffraction tomography can separately mechanophenotype the nucleus and cytoplasm of adherent cells, with model predictions of nanometer-scale motion and initial five-cell tomograms showing amplitude ratios below unity and negative relative phases that remain to be quantitatively validated.
summaries.zh: 本研究通过计算建模和初步实验，评估幅度调制兆赫兹超声结合锁相光学衍射层析成像能否分别对贴壁细胞的细胞核与细胞质进行力学表型测量，模型预测了纳米级运动，五细胞初步断层图显示振幅比小于一且相对相位为负，但仍需定量验证。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、振幅変調されたメガヘルツ超音波と位相ロック光回折トモグラフィーを組み合わせて接着細胞の核と細胞質を別々に力学的フェノタイピングできるかを計算モデルと初期実験で検討し、ナノメートル規模の運動を予測するとともに5細胞の初期トモグラムで振幅比が1未満、相対位相が負となる予備的結果を得たが、定量的な力学的検証には至っていない。

title: Relativistic Cavity Quantum Electrodynamical Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Method for Strong Light-Matter Coupling
abstract: We present the relativistic four-component implementation of cavity quantum electrodynamical algebraic diagrammatic construction theory at second order (4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)) for the ab initio treatment of light-matter interactions. Starting from the unitary-transformed, origin-invariant Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian, a rigorous four-component Dirac-Hartree-Fock formulation including cavity effects is considered, forming the basis of the 4c-QED-EE-ADC(2) framework. Two variants are implemented, allowing cavity effects to be introduced either at the relativistic mean-field or exclusively at the electron-correlation level. Applications to Hg, AuH, and halogen hydrides demonstrate that cavity coupling significantly modifies relativistic excitation spectra, induces strong state mixing, and enables tunable polaritonic features. Potential energy surface calculations for HBr further reveal cavity-induced qualitative changes in excited-state surfaces. It is also observed that the inclusion of photonic degrees of freedom leads to a moderate computational overhead of approximately three to five times relative to standard 4c-EE-ADC(2).

summaries.en: The paper presents a relativistic four-component implementation of cavity quantum electrodynamical algebraic diagrammatic construction at second order (4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)), built on the unitary-transformed origin-invariant Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian and Dirac-Hartree-Fock with cavity effects, which is shown to substantially modify relativistic excitation spectra and excited-state potential energy surfaces for systems such as Hg, AuH, and halogen hydrides while adding only a moderate three- to five-fold computational overhead.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了腔量子电动力学代数图解构造理论二阶方法的相对论四分量实现（4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)），其基于幺正变换的、原点不变的Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量以及包含腔效应的Dirac-Hartree-Fock框架，对Hg、AuH和卤化氢等体系的计算表明腔耦合显著改变相对论激发谱并诱导强态混合和可调极化激元特征，同时对HBr的势能面计算显示腔诱导的激发态势能面定性变化，而光子自由度的引入仅带来约三到五倍的适度计算开销。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ユニタリー変換された原点不変なPauli-Fierzハミルトニアンと腔内効果を含むDirac-Hartree-Fock定式化に基づく、腔量子電磁力学代数ダイアグラム構成法の相対論的四成分実装（4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)）を提示し、Hg、AuH、ハロゲン化水素への適用により腔結合が相対論的励起スペクトルを大きく変化させて強い状態混合と調整可能なポラリトン的特徴を誘起すること、HBrのポテンシャルエネルギー面計算が腔誘起の励起状態面の定性的変化を示すこと、光子自由度の導入による計算コストの増加は約3〜5倍と中程度であることを明らかにしている。

title: Polarization-resolved haze in transparent wood - towards wooden glass
abstract: Transparent wood (TW) composites possess residual haze that limits image clarity despite their high light transmission, yet the physical origin of this scattering has not been established. Here, polarization-resolved measurements reveal a pronounced polarization dependence of scattering by a wood-polymer composite with improved refractive index matching. Polarization- and spectrally-resolved haze as low as 21% (40-45% at 550 nm for unpolarized light) with transmittance of approximately 92% for polarization perpendicular to the fibers was detected. It is found that the low-haze spectrum closely follows an inverse-square relation over the 400-800 nm range, well described by a weak-index-contrast Rayleigh-Gans-Debye (RGD) model invoking subwavelength birefringent heterogeneities within the cell wall. This physical mechanism was previously obscured by haze-limiting strong scattering from debonding gaps or refraction at the lumen-cell wall interface. Scanning electron diffraction independently reveals spatially distinct domains with markedly different cellulose diffraction responses within the infiltrated cell walls. The observed polarization-dependent refractive-index mismatch is attributed to inherent cellulose birefringence. Time-resolved measurements further support nearly scattering-free quasi-ballistic transport of the sampled transmitted light. It is demonstrated that selecting only a preferential polarization markedly improves image visibility through TW without further material modification. These findings connect polarization-dependent haze to the internal structure of transparent wood and identify ways to engineer a refractive-index match in hierarchical anisotropic composites towards glass-like clarity.

summaries.en: Polarization-resolved measurements on a refractive-index-matched transparent wood composite reveal that its residual haze is minimized (down to 21%) for light polarized perpendicular to the fibers and follows an inverse-square wavelength dependence described by a weak-index-contrast Rayleigh-Gans-Debye model arising from subwavelength birefringent heterogeneities in the cell walls.
summaries.zh: 对折射率匹配的透明木材复合材料进行的偏振分辨测量表明，当光的偏振方向垂直于纤维时，其残余雾度最低可降至21%，且雾度随波长呈平方反比关系，这可由细胞壁中亚波长双折射异质结构引起的弱折射率对比瑞利-甘斯-德拜模型解释。
summaries.ja: 屈折率整合した透明木材複合材料の偏光分解測定により、繊維に垂直な偏光に対して残留ヘイズが最小21%まで低下し、その波長依存性は細胞壁内のサブ波長複屈折不均一に起因する弱屈折率コントラストのRayleigh-Gans-Debyeモデルで説明できることを示した。

title: Long-Baseline Phase-Coherent Microwave Reception Using Rydberg Atoms
abstract: A long baseline phase-coherent microwave receiver is demonstrated using a remotely interrogated cesium Rydberg atom sensor over an 8 m free-space optical link. A 3.989 GHz local oscillator (LO) is intensity-modulated onto an 852 nm optical probe and recovered remotely for atomic superheterodyne detection. A 509 nm coupling laser establishes a Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) system addressing the 6S1/2 to 6P3/2 to 56D5/2 ladder, with microwave coupling to 57P3/2. A test signal offset by 5 kHz generates an optically detected intermediate-frequency (IF) response returned to the reference station for centralized coherent acquisition. This eliminates independent remote oscillators, electronic IF acquisition, and distributed clock synchronization. Over 10 min, the differential phase between remote and local reference exhibits a standard deviation of 0.476 deg and a minimum overlapping phase Allan deviation of 0.048 deg at approximately 200 s averaging. Following optical-link interruption, the differential phase recovers without recalibration, with a measured pre- and post-interruption difference of 0.01 deg. These results demonstrate phase coherent remotely interrogated atomic microwave reception with reduced instrumentation, supporting future distributed interferometry, multistatic radar, and coherent sensor arrays.

title: Deep-Microscopic Photonic Bandstructure of a Two-Dimensional Honeycomb Lattice
abstract: Conventional descriptions of light in materials rely on macroscopic models that average the optical response over the microscopic lattice structures. These models are deployed in the semi-classical limit, where the collective local response over many lattice sites is adequate. However, they fail to capture the full spatial dispersion, which requires a lattice-resolved description of light. We address this limitation by formulating a deep-microscopic nonlocal theory of the photon based on the Maxwell Hamiltonian and its characteristic equation. The solution reveals the full spatial dispersion in the form of deep-microscopic photonic bandstructure, and corresponding real-space Bloch field textures. We demonstrate our theory for a two-dimensional (2D) tight-binding model of a gapped honeycomb lattice. Our framework thus extends photons to the same microscopic footing as electrons or phonons, providing a unified route to studying topology, dissipation, and quantum fluctuations of light in dispersive materials.

summaries.en: A deep-microscopic nonlocal photonic theory based on the Maxwell Hamiltonian reveals the full spatial dispersion as a deep-microscopic bandstructure and real-space Bloch field textures, demonstrated for a gapped 2D honeycomb tight-binding lattice.
summaries.zh: 基于麦克斯韦哈密顿量的深微观非局域光子理论揭示了完整的空间色散，给出深微观能带结构和实空间布洛赫场纹理，并在二维有隙蜂窝紧束缚模型中进行了演示。
summaries.ja: マクスウェルハミルトニアンに基づく深微視的非局所フォトン理論により、完全な空間分散を深微視的バンド構造と実空間ブロッホ場テクスチャとして明らかにし、ギャップを持つ2次元ハニカム格子の強結合模型で実証した。

title: Optical imaging with only the evanescent fields and without diffraction
abstract: We report on a conceptual framework for optical imaging utilizing exclusively evanescent fields, effectively eliminating or attenuating standard optical diffraction. We present the theoretical foundation of this concept based on the decomposition of dipole radiation into evanescent fields and homogeneous propagating waves, exploring the explicit conditions required to suppress the latter. By successfully decoupling and removing the homogeneous component, optical tasks, such as sub-diffraction imaging, can be executed solely via evanescent channels, bypassing traditional diffractive limits. We discuss the physical feasibility of this approach and provide concrete examples of how this conjecture can be realized using currently available laboratory and industrial techniques. The realization of this concept promises to redefine core paradigms in optics and fundamental physics. Because the minimum achievable feature size is no longer governed by the operating wavelength, this approach enables an unprecedented increase in spatial resolution, offering a direct pathway to advance state-of-the-art semiconductor lithography and chip manufacturing.

summaries.en: The paper presents a conceptual framework for optical imaging that uses exclusively evanescent fields by decomposing dipole radiation and suppressing the homogeneous propagating waves, thereby removing standard diffraction limits and enabling sub-diffraction imaging with potential applications in semiconductor lithography and chip manufacturing.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种仅利用倏逝场进行光学成像的概念框架，通过将偶极辐射分解为倏逝场和均匀传播波并抑制后者，从而消除标准衍射极限，实现亚衍射成像，并有望应用于半导体光刻和芯片制造。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、双極子放射をエバネッセント場と均一な伝搬波に分解して後者を抑制することで、標準的な回折限界を排除し、エバネッセント場のみを用いたサブ回折イメージングを可能にし、半導体リソグラフィーやチップ製造への応用が期待される概念的な枠組みを提示する。

title: Polarized X-rays from table-top free-electron-driven van der Waals crystals
abstract: Polarized X-rays are essential for polarization-sensitive techniques such as X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectroscopy, magnetic microscopy, and fluorescence imaging. These techniques are crucial in the study of molecular and material dynamics, which are in turn central to driving the global transition to clean energy and sustainability through research in photovoltaics, catalysis and optoelectronics. Currently, polarized X-rays with tunable polarization and photon energy are available only in large facilities like synchrotrons. Here, we theoretically predict and experimentally demonstrate the generation of linearly polarized X-rays from free electron-driven van der Waals crystals, without the need for additional optical stages like polarizers. We show that precise, real-time control over the polarization can be achieved by simply re-orienting the van der Waals crystal. Furthermore, we show that a high degree of polarization can be achieved across all polarization angles - from perpendicular to in-plane - with intensities exceeding 10^9 photons s^(-1) sr^(-1) mA^(-1). Using our findings, we present a scheme for table-top XANES, achieving performance comparable to that of synchrotron facilities. In the process, we develop a new methodology for performing XANES using high-quality polarized X-rays with larger spectral linewidths, named ORIXANES (Orientation-controlled XANES). Our findings pave the way to greater accessibility and smaller carbon footprint for advanced X-ray modalities.

summaries.en: The paper theoretically predicts and experimentally demonstrates that free electron-driven van der Waals crystals can generate tunable, highly linearly polarized X-rays across all polarization angles with intensities exceeding 10^9 photons s^(-1) sr^(-1) mA^(-1), enabling a table-top XANES scheme called ORIXANES with synchrotron-comparable performance.
summaries.zh: 该论文从理论上预测并经实验证明了自由电子驱动的范德华晶体能够产生可调、高度线偏振的X射线，其偏振角覆盖从垂直方向到面内方向且强度超过10^9 photons s^(-1) sr^(-1) mA^(-1)，从而实现性能可与同步辐射媲美的桌面式XANES方案ORIXANES。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、自由電子駆動のファンデルワールス結晶から、あらゆる偏光角で高度に直線偏光したX線を10^9 photons s^(-1) sr^(-1) mA^(-1)を超える強度で発生できることを理論的に予測し実験的に実証し、同期放射光に匹敵する性能を持つ卓上型XANES方式ORIXANESを実現した。

title: Accurate measurement of Lithium Tantalate birefringence in whispering gallery resonators
abstract: Lithium Tantalate (LTA) is an important ferroelectric crystal widely used in piezoelectric, electro-optic, and nonlinear optical devices. Although this crystal is very common, there is an ongoing debate regarding its birefringence magnitude, and even its sign. While some sources claim it to be negative, others maintain that it is positive. The issue is further complicated by the sample-to-sample variation in the crystal composition, ranging from congruent to stoichiometric. Here we report the experimental exploration of this question based on high-resolution spectroscopy of optical whispering gallery resonators fabricated from this crystal. These sensitive measurements unambiguously indicate that in the near-infrared range at room temperature the stoichiometric LTA is negative, while the congruent LTA is positive.

summaries.en: High-resolution spectroscopy of optical whispering gallery resonators shows that at room temperature in the near-infrared, stoichiometric lithium tantalate is negative birefringent while congruent lithium tantalate is positive birefringent, resolving the debate over its birefringence sign and magnitude.

title: Non-Hermitian Topology of a Subwavelength Resonator in Synthetic Space
abstract: Non-Hermitian singularities and the nontrivial topology of energy bands have been extensively explored in extended periodic systems, where phenomena such as exceptional points and bulk Fermi arcs are naturally associated with periodicity and momentum space. Here, we show that this non-Hermitian topology can be extended to the domain of subwavelength resonators using a synthetic space. By reconstructing the complex energy bands of a subwavelength ring resonator in the synthetic space of geometrical parameters, we experimentally observe a spectral triplet formed by two exceptional points (EPs) connected by a bulk Fermi arc and a topologically robust quasi-bound state in the continuum (q-BIC). This Fermi-arc q-BIC emerges exactly at the intersection of the bulk Fermi arc and the q-BIC line in synthetic space, establishing a direct topological link between two spectral singularities. Encircling the EPs in synthetic space visualizes the nontrivial topology of the complex energy-band structure and reveals the opposite half-integer topological charges of the EPs connected by the bulk Fermi arc. These results extend non-Hermitian topology to subwavelength structures and establish compact resonators as a versatile platform for applications in photonics, microwave physics, and acoustics.

summaries.en: By reconstructing the complex energy bands of a subwavelength ring resonator in a synthetic space of geometrical parameters, the authors experimentally observe two exceptional points connected by a bulk Fermi arc and a topologically robust quasi-bound state in the continuum that emerges at the intersection of the Fermi arc and the q-BIC line, revealing the opposite half-integer topological charges of the exceptional points.

title: Surface Functionalization with Lasers: from Nanostructures to Applications
abstract: Pulsed laser sources stand out as remarkable and versatile tools in the growing interdisciplinary field of materials science, offering capabilities for tailoring and customizing materials to meet specific requirements. Their ability to induce different controlled material alterations allows enhancing material properties that might otherwise remain elusive. In essence, laser-induced material modifications encompass a spectrum of transformative processes, ranging from subtle topographical changes in the nano- and microscale, to intricate chemical modifications. Among the challenges to overcome are the creation of approaches that allow tuning the properties of light to optimize interactions on various types of solids, including metals, semiconductors, and dielectrics. Understanding these interactions is paramount towards efficiency increase of the processing techniques. This chapter embarks on a comprehensive exploration of the intricate dance between pulsed laser beams and their interaction with matter at the surface. The applications of laser-induced surface modifications are far-reaching and extend into widespread industrial fields. Examples of these include tribology, where the study of friction, wear, and lubrication is paramount. Besides that, the modified surfaces find applications in wetting phenomena, changing surface energy and contact angle control, enhanced welding processes, and optimizing molecular adhesion for stronger and durable interfaces. The ability to precisely engineer material surface properties through laser processing opens new frontiers in materials and surface sciences, offering innovative solutions and pushing the boundaries of what can be achieved in various industrial and technological domains.

summaries.en: This chapter comprehensively reviews how pulsed laser beams interact with metal, semiconductor, and dielectric surfaces to produce controlled topographical and chemical modifications, enabling applications ranging from tribology and wetting control to enhanced welding and molecular adhesion.

title: Compressive microendoscopy in the presence of noise and misalignment: the translational correlation advantage of graded-index fibers
abstract: Multimode fibers (MMFs) offer a minimally invasive platform for deep-tissue and multisite in vivo optical sensing. Computational microendoscopy methods extend them into the high-resolution imaging domain, but are quite sensitive to experimental errors. This study investigates the robustness of microendoscopy based on compressive sensing (CS) by comparing step-index (SI) MMFs with graded-index (GRIN) fibers. Mode-expansion-based simulations are used to assess the accuracy of image reconstruction in the presence of fundamental photon noise and lateral fiber shifts. We show that both fiber types exhibit comparable noise sensitivity, but GRIN fibers are significantly more robust to lateral misalignment errors. These results establish GRIN MMFs as an alignment-tolerant platform for robust computational microendoscopy.

summaries.en: Simulations of compressive-sensing microendoscopy show that graded-index multimode fibers match step-index fibers in noise sensitivity but are significantly more robust to lateral misalignment, making them an alignment-tolerant platform for computational microendoscopy.

title: Nonreciprocal magneto-optic beam steering of thermal emission
abstract: Conventional thermal emitters obey Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation, which ties absorptivity to emissivity and places a fundamental limit on a range of radiative energy technologies and sensing systems. This constraint can be overcome using magneto-optic materials, which exhibit nonreciprocal thermal emission under an applied magnetic field. While the spectral nonreciprocity of magneto-optic devices has been explored theoretically and experimentally, nonreciprocal control over the direction of thermal emission has received far less attention. Here, we propose and numerically demonstrate nonreciprocal beam steering of thermal emission, wherein an applied magnetic field lifts the degeneracy between guided modes at +/- kx, enabling asymmetric and tunable directional thermal emission. We highlight a III-V semiconductor photonic structure operating at 24.5 um, a wavelength with few laser sources. This structure exhibits a nonreciprocity greater than 0.5 between +/- 75 degrees at 50 mT, a peak emissivity asymmetry over 0.6 at 150 mT, and 22 degrees of beam steering between 0 and 1 T. Our approach provides a solid-state means of steering a thermal beam, offering a potential route to magnetically controlled beam scanning of incandescent sources.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and numerically demonstrates nonreciprocal magneto-optic beam steering of thermal emission using a III-V semiconductor photonic structure at 24.

title: Experimental Evidence for Reflected Ions and Ion Temperature Anisotropy in a Forming Supercritical Magnetized Collisionless Shock
abstract: Supercritical magnetized collisionless shocks require ion reflection for dissipation, yet its role during formation remains unclear. Using high-power lasers, self-emission imaging, and collective Thomson scattering, we investigate a forming quasi-perpendicular shock. An upstream emission tail is consistent with a foot-like structure, while ion heating and temperature anisotropy extend upstream of a ramp-like region. These observations provide evidence of reflected-ion-related heating during early shock formation, although the incident and reflected ion populations are not separately resolved. Future measurements of ion distributions and plasma waves could clarify how this heating mediates shock dissipation and particle energization.

title: Functional Superoscillations in a Wave Processor
abstract: Physical wave processors are constrained by diffraction, but the bandwidth of the mathematical functions they implement need not be set by it. Here, we demonstrate continuous and multiplexed optical processing of superoscillatory functions, in which a scalar argument is encoded onto a wavefront and a fixed diffractive wave processor synthesizes optical responses that approximate the corresponding function outputs in parallel. Unlike conventional superoscillatory optics that generates predetermined fields, superoscillation here is expressed in the input-output dependence on the encoded argument. Its frequencies are therefore distinct from the transverse spatial frequencies of propagating light and are not subject to the same diffraction-imposed cutoff. We demonstrate complex-valued superoscillatory function synthesis and introduce a multiplexed architecture that simultaneously evaluates distinct target superoscillatory functions whose harmonic content exceeds that of the optical input encoding. Visible-light experiments further validate this beyond-encoding superoscillatory regime. Together, these results establish functional superoscillation as a design principle for wave-based computation and show how interference, diffractive depth and spatial channel allocation extend the functional reach of passive wave processors. More broadly, these analyses establish a separation between functional bandwidth and physical wave bandwidth in analog optical computation.

summaries.en: This work demonstrates functional superoscillation in a passive diffractive wave processor that synthesizes and multiplexes superoscillatory functions in parallel, where the function's harmonic content exceeds the optical input encoding and is not limited by the diffraction-imposed cutoff on propagating spatial frequencies, thereby separating functional bandwidth from physical wave bandwidth in analog optical computation.

title: Axion Quasibound States in the Continuum and Their Enhanced Axion Nonlinearity
abstract: Dynamical axion quasiparticles (DAQs) in condensed-matter systmes have emerged as a fascinating platform for exploring axion physics and nonlinear optical phenomena. However, the amplitude of the coherent oscillating $\theta$ field is even smaller than that of the static counterpart, making the experimental observation of DAQs particularly challenging. Here, we introduce symmetry-sensitive bound states in the continuum (BICs) physics to enable the all-optical detection of DAQs and enhance DAQ-mediated second-harmonic generation (SHG). Specifically, we uncover that DAQs induce optical shear that breaks the $C_{2z}$ symmetry of metagratings without geometric engineering, thereby converting symmetry-protected BICs into axion quasi-BICs (qBICs). In this context, the evolution of the quality factor and topological charge in momentum space, together with the appearance of optical resonances in far field associated with axion qBICs, offers achiral optical signatures for DAQ detection beyond the widely used Kerr and Faraday effects. Furthermore, by exploiting axion qBICs in the critical coupling regime to enhance fundamental optical field, we show that the SHG efficiency can be enhanced more than $10^5$-fold compared to bulk axion materials, achieving a conversion efficiency exceeding $10^{-6}~W^{-1}$. The SHG is governed by the magnetoelectric coupling, which differs from that in conventional SHG materials. Our findings establish a new approach for probing DAQs via achiral optical effects, while providing a versatile route for reconfigurable photonics and terahertz nonlinear optics.

summaries.en: The paper shows that dynamical axion quasiparticles induce optical shear that breaks the C2z symmetry of metagratings, converting symmetry-protected bound states in the continuum into axion quasi-BICs whose momentum-space quality-factor and topological-charge evolution provides achiral optical signatures for all-optical axion detection and whose critical-coupling field enhancement boosts axion-mediated second-harmonic generation efficiency by more than 10^5-fold compared with bulk axion materials.

title: Suppression of Sedimentation in Polystyrene Microsphere Suspensions via Femtosecond Laser Irradiation
abstract: Micrometer-sized particles denser than their medium settle out of suspension within hours, and Brownian motion is too weak to prevent it. We report that femtosecond laser irradiation at 1030 nm slows this settling in suspensions of 8 um polystyrene microspheres in water, without altering the particles themselves. Suspensions at three concentrations were treated for up to 3 h under weak acoustic agitation or vigorous magnetic stirring, each with and without simultaneous irradiation, and the particles remaining in the probe volume were quantified optically by angle-resolved Mie scattering. Under acoustic agitation, irradiation raised retention in eleven of twelve paired comparisons, at every concentration, by 0.17 on average against a measured aliquot-to-aliquot scatter of 0.02; the twelfth comparison lies within that scatter. Under stirring, which already keeps most particles suspended, it produces no resolvable change. The angular positions of the Mie maxima are unchanged to within about 1% over 3 h, so the particles are neither fragmented nor aggregated and the effect arises from particle transport rather than from changes in the particles. An order-of-magnitude analysis rules out optical forces, the optical Kerr effect, and transient photochemistry, and leaves laser-driven convection: the power absorbed by the water sustains flows orders of magnitude faster than the 1.8 um/s settling velocity. Femtosecond irradiation therefore acts as a non-contact, supplementary agitation source, most effective where mechanical mixing is weak.

summaries.en: Femtosecond laser irradiation at 1030 nm slows the sedimentation of 8 µm polystyrene microspheres in water without altering the particles, an effect attributed to laser-driven convection rather than optical forces or photochemistry.

title: Yb/Sr optical clock comparison at 2.2E-18 uncertainty over a 1350-km fiber link
abstract: Redefining the International system of Units (SI) second requires independent frequency-ratio measurements between clocks based on different laboratories, with an overall uncertainty below 5E-18, to validate individual clock evaluations through consistency checks. Reaching this uncertainty over long distances has remained challenging. So far, comparisons at this level have been achieved only a few times, between co-located clocks, and their results disagree markedly. Previous high-precision comparisons have therefore been limited to local or kilometre-scale links. Here we compare a ytterbium optical lattice clock in Wuhan with a strontium optical lattice clock in Shanghai over a phase-stabilized fiber link spanning 1350 km, and determine the Yb/Sr frequency ratio to be 1.207 507 039 343 337 716 0(26), with a Bayesian statistical uncertainty of 1.14E-18 and a total uncertainty of 2.18E-18. To our knowledge, this is the first intercity long distance frequency-ratio measurement, whose total uncertainty reaches the level required by the redefinition roadmap. The measured ratio exhibits a significant correlation with Earth tides and its response agree with the model within the statistical uncertainty. At intercity scale, this comparison demonstrates the capability of an optical-clock network for frequency comparison and Earths gravitational-potential sensing, a key step toward a wide-area optical-clock network.
